main.description: A place to eat, as an author names it. An object, not a record: it is embedded in an at.eaten.visit. Two places are the same place when they share any (service, id) pair in ids; names and addresses are for people.

name.description: The place's name, as the author gives it.

address.description: A one-line street address, for display and for a map link.

price.description: Price band, 1 (cheapest) to 4, conventionally shown as that many currency signs.

ids.description: Identifiers for the place in external systems, for matching the same place across write-ups.

urls.description: Places to read more, in the author's preferred order.

externalId.description: The place's identifier in one external system. Match is exact on both service and id.

service.description: The system the id belongs to. googlePlace is a Google Maps place id; applePlace an Apple Maps place id; overtureGers an Overture Maps GERS id. Values outside knownValues belong to the authoring client's own vocabulary and MUST be preserved on rewrite.

id.description: The identifier, exactly as the system issues it.

service.description: What this URL is. Consumers dispatch service-specific rendering on an exact match against knownValues. Values outside knownValues belong to the authoring client's own vocabulary and MUST be preserved on rewrite and rendered as a plain link.
